grill_me_architect.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree.

review_against_specs.description: Review an implementation against a feature specification. Identifies missing, incorrect, or extra functionality, as well as spec gaps and testing issues. Does not modify code.

specs_reviewer.description: Reviews feature specifications for clarity, completeness, and alignment with product and architecture before implementation
